subject: Action items: Evaluation success metrics & access checklist
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia@datascale.ai>, Tim Chen <tim@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: evaluation success metrics & initial access items

Hi Olivia / Tim — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned for the two-week eval window:

Summary of success criteria (from today):
- Latency: 95th pctile request latency < 220ms for your 512-token prompts
- Cost target: <$0.003/token for steady-state inference on your sample workload
- Quality: >90% pass rate on the 12 custom prompts in the eval suite (attached)

Evaluation plan & owners:
- Redwood will provide a scoped API key + streaming endpoint for usage (owner: karthik_iyer)
- Datascale to run the automated eval harness and submit results daily (owner: Olivia)
- CS (marissa_cole) will monitor errors and help tune batching/cache settings

Access items we need from your side to get started:
1) SSO: list of SAML admin(s) to invite (Name + email) or confirmation you want magic-link invites
2) IP allowlist: the list of public egress IPs for your test infra (or CIDR ranges)
3) Test users: a short roster (name, role, email) so we can apply RBAC for the eval

Tentative timeline:
- 07/09: Redwood to prepare scoped API key and create SSO invite template
- 07/10: Datascale provides SAML metadata + roster + IPs
- 07/12: Credentials delivered; test harness launch
- 07/22: End of two-week run, results review call

I attached a short access matrix template to make it easy to fill in. If that timeline looks good, reply with the SSO admin(s) and IPs and I’ll kick off the internal ops requests.

Thanks — Karthik
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: datascale-eval-access-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

SSO admin(s):

IP egress for test cluster (public):

Test roster (short):
- Olivia Park — Product — olivia@datascale.ai

Thanks — Olivia

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc:

Subject: Access request: Datascale eval — SSO invites + scoped API key (ownering and deadlines)

FYI / action for ops:
I have confirmed the team and IPs from Datascale. Please provision the following by EOD 2026-07-12: 
- Create a scoped, read-only API key limited to the evaluation model endpoint and set rate limits per the attached template (owner: stephanie_nguyen)
- Prepare SSO invite flow: send SAML invite placeholder to Olivia and Rajiv; we will provide SAML metadata once they upload it (owner: marissa_cole)
- Add the two IP ranges 35.201.12.0/24 and 34.82.45.128/27 to the allowlist on the eval routing; add note in ticket for rollback after 30 days (owner: stephanie_nguyen)

Please attach the created API key stub and the invite links to the ticket. I’ve attached the access matrix they filled for reference. Let me know if you need anything else from the Datascale side (e.g., SSO cert).

Thanks — K

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access request: Datascale eval — SSO invites + scoped API key (ownering and deadlines)

On it. Quick status / plan and delivery ETA: 
- API key: I will generate a read-only key scoped to the model inference endpoints (no admin/rollout permissions). Will apply token-level rate limit (500 req/min) and a daily cap. ETA: 2026-07-09 10:00 PT. Attached is the key stub that we deliver by email to the customer (redwood-mock-api-key.txt).
- IP allowlist: I’ve queued the network change for the eval pool. Will apply 35.201.12.0/24 and 34.82.45.128/27 to the eval routing rules with a rollback tag. ETA: 2026-07-09 15:00 PT.
- SSO invites: We can do two options — (A) send SSO invites with a magic-link once they confirm metadata, or (B) wait for their IdP metadata and create a SAML-enabled org. I recommend sending magic-link invites for the three test users so they can begin earlier; once Rajiv provides SAML metadata we’ll convert to SAML. Will send invite email draft for approval. ETA (invites): 2026-07-10 11:00 PT.

Deliverables I’ll attach to the ticket when complete: redwood-mock-api-key.txt, audit note with allowlist change, and invite email copy. If you want me to include a short runbook for the team (how to run the harness against our streaming endpoint), I can add that as well.

— Stephanie
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-mock-api-key.txt (text)]
